data.long_meaning: Jaganmaya is a name of the goddess Durga, meaning 'mother of the universe'. She is revered as the mother of the cosmos, the mother of all beings and the mother of the universe. The name Jaganmayi carries the meaning “Goddess of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaganmayi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of universal motherhood and protection.
data.etymology: Jaganmayi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaganmayi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaganmaya reflects the deep reverence for the feminine divine in Hindu culture. It is a reminder of the central role that the goddess Durga plays in Hindu beliefs and practices. The name is commonly used in various temples, festivals, and rituals dedicated to Durga and her various forms. It underscores the importance of motherly love, compassion, and protection in Hindu philosophy.
data.spiritual_significance: Jaganmaya, as a name of the goddess Durga, represents the ultimate nurturing and protective force in the universe. It is a reminder of the divine mother's unconditional love, compassion, and care for all her children. The name inspires devotion, faith, and surrender, as one seeks the protection, guidance, and blessings of the Mother of the Universe. It is a powerful name that evokes feelings of safety, security, and strength, reminding one of the power and presence of the Divine Mother in their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jaganmaya signifies the embodiment of universal Mother Goddess, nurturing all souls with her infinite love and compassion. Her name represents the divine presence within everyone, guiding and protecting us throughout our spiritual journey.
